The Dia LatelyNovember 12th2026

Find your flow

We all know what it’s like to hit our flow state. Moving between thoughts is smooth sailing. Tools become an extension of your mind to put ideas into action. This week, Dia helps you get there with updates to how you organize your thoughts, and how you turn those thoughts into something awesome.

Nest your tab groups

Your tab groups can now hold groups of their own, so organizing even the most complicated project can just flow. Drag one group into another, or right-click a group and choose New Group. Nested groups take on their parent's color, and you can nest up to eight levels deep. Available on Mac and Windows.

Shipped by connor

Dia can now design in Figma

Until now, Dia could only read your Figma files. Now it can make them too!

Connect Figma in Settings → Apps, and Dia can create, edit and read your Figma. You can ask Dia to create Figma Slides right from chat, make FigJam boards to visualize your latest brainstorm or edit your designs to include the latest round of feedback. Try: "make a Figma Slides with our end of year plans."

Shipped by

  • Farah

  • Fill in the blanks

    Bring a template and let Dia add in the context from your latest work. Dia can pull details from a Slack conversation, a doc or a calendar event and drop them where they belong. Try: "make an event flyer for our upcoming hackathon using the details from Slack."

  • Read between the layers

    Dia still does everything it did in Beta. It searches your files and projects, reads the comments, and pulls the text and layers from your designs and FigJams. Ask what's in a design, grab the copy without screenshotting it, or write a talk track from a set of slides. Try: "summarize the unresolved feedback on the launch design and prioritize the feedback to address."

Dia always asks before it creates anything in your Figma account, so nothing shows up in your files without your OK. Don't see your app? Have a note? Let us know!

What else is new

  • Attach Office files to chat.

    Attach Excel, Word, and PowerPoint files to Chat for summaries, answers, and key points.

    Shipped by

  • Choose whether new Tabs open inside a Tab Group.

    Choose whether links open new Tabs inside a Group by right-clicking on the Tab Group, including Nested Groups.

    Shipped by

  • Smarter calendar, search, and app connections.

    Dia now recognizes out-of-office events, gets more out of Notion, Slack, and GitHub searches, and keeps sign-in pop-ups and Zoom prompts from getting in your way.

    Shipped by Ali

  • Import unpinned tabs from Arc.

    Arc imports now include unpinned tabs alongside Favorites and Pinned Tabs for a more complete migration to Dia.

    Shipped by

For a full list of the changes this week, check out our changelog.
